# 词典 N

## 概述

本页收录以字母 N 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设补充词汇、常用短语、易混淆词辨析与学习提示，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇           | 词性    | 含义                 | 常见搭配                 | 例句                                                                  |
| -------------- | ------- | -------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| negotiate      | v.      | 谈判；协商           | negotiate a contract     | We need to negotiate the contract terms before signing.               |
| notify         | v.      | 通知；告知           | notify the team          | Please notify the team about the schedule change.                     |
| nominal        | adj.    | 名义上的；微不足道的 | nominal fee              | The service is available for a nominal monthly fee.                   |
| niche          | n./adj. | 利基市场；专业领域   | niche market             | The product targets a niche market of data engineers.                 |
| nurture        | v.      | 培养；培育           | nurture talent           | Good managers nurture talent within their teams.                      |
| net            | adj.    | 净的；纯的           | net profit / net income  | The company reported a net profit of $2 million this quarter.         |
| navigate       | v.      | 导航；应对           | navigate challenges      | She skillfully navigated the team through a difficult transition.     |
| non-disclosure | adj.    | 保密的               | non-disclosure agreement | All contractors must sign a non-disclosure agreement before starting. |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇       | 词性  | 含义               | 常见搭配           | 例句                                                            |
| ---------- | ----- | ------------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| nostalgia  | n.    | 怀旧；乡愁         | feel nostalgia     | The old photos filled her with nostalgia for college days.      |
| nurture    | v./n. | 养育；滋养         | nature vs. nurture | The debate between nature and nurture continues in psychology.  |
| nimble     | adj.  | 灵活的；敏捷的     | nimble response    | A nimble response to market changes is key for startups.        |
| nuance     | n.    | 细微差别；微妙之处 | subtle nuance      | Understanding the nuances of English idioms takes time.         |
| narrative  | n.    | 叙事；故事线       | brand narrative    | The marketing team crafted a compelling brand narrative.        |
| notably    | adv.  | 尤其；显著地       | most notably       | Several features improved, most notably the search performance. |
| necessity  | n.    | 必要性；必需品     | out of necessity   | Remote work tools became a necessity during the pandemic.       |
| neighborly | adj.  | 友善的；睦邻的     | neighborly gesture | Bringing coffee to a new colleague is a neighborly gesture.     |

## 技术相关

| 词汇      | 词性    | 含义              | 常见搭配               | 例句                                                                 |
| --------- | ------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| node      | n.      | 节点              | Node.js / cluster node | Each node in the cluster handles a portion of the traffic.           |
| namespace | n.      | 命名空间          | define a namespace     | Use namespaces to avoid naming conflicts in large projects.          |
| null      | adj./n. | 空值              | null check             | Always perform a null check before accessing object properties.      |
| npm       | n.      | Node 包管理器     | npm install            | Run npm install to download all project dependencies.                |
| NoSQL     | n.      | 非关系型数据库    | NoSQL database         | MongoDB is one of the most popular NoSQL databases.                  |
| network   | n./v.   | 网络；建立关系    | network latency        | High network latency causes timeout errors in distributed systems.   |
| native    | adj.    | 原生的；本地的    | React Native           | React Native allows building cross-platform mobile apps.             |
| nginx     | n.      | 高性能 Web 服务器 | configure nginx        | We use nginx as a reverse proxy in front of our application servers. |

## 补充词汇

| 词汇        | 词性    | 含义           | 常见搭配               | 例句                                                              |
| ----------- | ------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| negligible  | adj.    | 可忽略不计的   | negligible impact      | The performance difference between the two methods is negligible. |
| novice      | n./adj. | 新手；初学者   | complete novice        | The tutorial is designed for complete novices in programming.     |
| noteworthy  | adj.    | 值得注意的     | noteworthy achievement | Her contribution to the project was a noteworthy achievement.     |
| nitpick     | v./n.   | 吹毛求疵       | nitpick details        | Try not to nitpick during code reviews; focus on major issues.    |
| nonetheless | adv.    | 尽管如此；然而 | but nonetheless        | The task was challenging, but the team delivered nonetheless.     |

## 常用短语

| 短语               | 含义           | 例句                                                               |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| narrow down        | 缩小范围       | Let's narrow down the list of candidates to the top five.          |
| nip in the bud     | 防患于未然     | We should nip this bug in the bud before it reaches production.    |
| no-brainer         | 显而易见的选择 | Upgrading to the new framework was a no-brainer for the team.      |
| not rocket science | 并非难事       | Setting up a CI pipeline is not rocket science with modern tools.  |
| nail down          | 确定；敲定     | We need to nail down the requirements before starting development. |
| next steps         | 后续步骤       | Let's discuss the next steps for the migration plan.               |
| not a big deal     | 没什么大不了   | Missing one standup is not a big deal, just catch up async.        |

## 易混淆词辨析

| 词组                     | 区别说明                                                          |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| notify vs. inform        | notify 更正式，常用于官方通知；inform 更通用。                    |
| notable vs. noteworthy   | 含义接近，notable 更侧重"著名的"，noteworthy 更侧重"值得关注的"。 |
| negligent vs. negligible | negligent 指"疏忽的（人）"，negligible 指"微不足道的（事物）"。   |

## 学习提示

- **negotiate** 在商务场景中是核心动词，掌握其名词形式 negotiation 同样重要。
- **namespace** 和 **null** 是几乎所有编程语言中都会用到的基础概念。
- **npm** 是 JavaScript 生态中最重要的包管理工具，面试中经常涉及相关问题。
- **nuance** 是表达"细微差别"的高级词汇，在讨论技术方案的优劣时非常有用。
- **no-brainer** 是口语中非常地道的表达，用于形容不需要费脑子就能做出的决定。
- **non-disclosure agreement（NDA）** 是入职签约时的常见文件，务必理解其含义。
